data.title: Makkah Chamber Holds Workshop on Updated Tourism Licensing Regulations
data.content:
Makkah, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The Makkah Chamber of Commerce, in cooperation with the Ministry of Tourism, organized a workshop on the updated tourism licensing regulations via the TEAMS platform to highlight the key regulatory updates covering tourism activities: travel and tourism services, tour guiding, hospitality facilities, and private hospitality units. The workshop also explained the improvements made to the procedures and requirements governing the practice of tourism activities.
    The workshop reviewed the objectives of the updates, which aim to keep pace with the growth of the tourism sector and the development of business models.
    It also highlighted the main provisions of the updated regulations, including simplifying license categories for travel and tourism services, expanding the scope of services, and increasing operational flexibility.
    The workshop also reviewed updates to the regulations governing hospitality facilities, including improvements to licensing, classification, and operational procedures, as well as the shift from permits to licenses for regulating private hospitality units.
    The workshop is part of efforts to raise awareness of regulatory updates in the tourism sector and help investors and activity operators understand the new requirements. These efforts support the sector's sustainable growth, improve the quality of the tourism experience, and enhance the competitiveness of tourist destinations across the Kingdom.
    -- SPA
